reason: A DSH client plugin whose primary purpose is applying a reversible QQ 2007-inspired visual skin while preserving native interactions, with optional local preferences and a short synthesized send cue.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH Web GUI 改造成 QQ 2007 风格复古界面的可切换主题插件，同时保留原生交互并提供可选提示音。
summaries.en: A switchable DSH Web GUI theme plugin that applies a QQ 2007-inspired retro interface while preserving native interactions and offering an optional send sound.

capabilities: Registers and applies client-side theme tokens and scoped CSS to restyle the DSH Web GUI
Adds decorative interface assets and responsive layout changes
Stores skin, sound, and previous-theme preferences in browser localStorage
Optionally synthesizes a short send-action sound with Web Audio
Adds and removes UI event listeners and lifecycle-managed decorations
